description: Restaurants, bars, café, spa, room and beach service of the five hotels of Corissia Resorts: access, opening hours, services with prices, reservation, menu sections. With hotel: the venues its guests may use, each with access_for_hotel (as hotel guest, or as other guest under a condition such as "adults, with reservation"). Hours, prices and access as published on the website (they may change; hours may vary by season). access: hotel_guests, other_guests with their condition, external_guests, min_age with age_note. The connector does not reserve tables or treatments; reservation has the reservation URL and phones of the venue, and reservation null means that the website offers no reservation. What a board (half board, all inclusive) includes is not part of this answer. API v3.

hotel.description: Only the venues the guests of this hotel may use.

lang.description: Language of names, texts and links: de or en (default en).
